reason: On uv 0.12.3 (Linux x86_64, CPython 3.12.3), `uv pip install --target <temp-target> --no-index badstar-1.0.0-py3-none-any.whl` failed for a minimal wheel containing `Requires-Python: >= 3.5.*`, reporting `Operator >= cannot be used with a wildcard version specifier`.
